description: Angular component for configuring common map settings in a widget, including form controls, validation, and dynamic enabling/disabling of fields based on provider type.

classes.name: CommonMapSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing map settings with form validation and dynamic controls.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form group and sets up value change subscription.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, especially provider changes.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for propagating value changes.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Patches form with provided value and updates validators.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates change.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables/disables form controls based on provider type.
